title: Silver Legion Keep
subtitle: Zaikhal keep, 16 Viamontian Man-at-Arms for the kill task

notes.title: Legion Door not needed
notes.body: The locked Legion Door (key dropped by the Doorkeeper) leads past every Man-at-Arms spawn, so you can ignore it and the lever.

notes.title: Use fire or lightning
notes.body: Man-at-Arms take 120% from fire and lightning, 90% from bludgeon and cold, and only 80% from slash and pierce.

notes.title: Respawn
notes.body: Only 16 Man-at-Arms here, back about every 2 minutes. Pair it with Copper Legion Keep (35) to reach 50.

notes.title: Stairs
notes.body: Some stairs here are separate objects the map can't draw, so the sweep assumes you can climb where it goes up a level.
